title: Separate certified clean-call delivery from termination after corrupted in-flight state
statement: The capacity-one binary protocol has six keys, SYNCHRO, typed PC/counter normalization and atomic bounded-support RX+queue+reACK. The31-event word POLL(SEND,RX,POLL)^10 reaches prefix DONE from all4,078,368 typed states (2,718,912 active). On113,288 fresh-call states with held input, ready destination and no new faults/arrivals, it delivers the current bit exactly once with one ACK. The supplied enumeration also reports1,100,456 corrupted in-flight starts completing without current-payload delivery. The clean-word window31/Lambda has p=exp(-31)*31^31/31!*(lambda_min/Lambda)^31, about1.157e-16 for three equal rates. First DONE is neither clean reset nor stale-state purification; adequate streaming service, split-RX implementation and recurring protection remain unpaid. These are source-reported checks, not new Capital enumeration.
